label: Global Euclidean access gives Euclidean access at one world
meaning: Strength registration (not a route step): global Euclidean access, instantiated at the selected world w, gives Euclidean access at w on the same frame. The converse fails in Control.clustered.

strong_version_needed.62b4a40a-919e-5da4-998c-131c386b7361: The global version is the object of this strength comparison, not a premise asserted of any frame; only its instances at the selected world are consumed.
